== Attribution uncertain ==
This sheet names no player; its footer file name is <code>joels_day2.html</code>. It is published under [[Joe Olson]] because he was the only Joe among the four players of Day 2, but the decks posted for him on Saturday were different. The evidence and comparisons are on [[Talk:2008 Texas Match Play Championship#How the sheets were attributed]]; the open question is on [[Mysteries#2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 sheets|Mysteries]]. If the attribution is settled, update the page, remove the <nowiki>{{Mystery}}</nowiki> flag and move the Mysteries entry to Solved.
